# Create: Neo Blazing Blood

**Create: Neo Blazing Blood** is a modern port of the original [Create: Blazing Blood](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-blazing-blood) mod to newer Minecraft versions, built on the **NeoForge** mod loader.

This mod kept all original textures and recipes, which were created by [LessThanPro](https://modrinth.com/user/LessThanPro). I only ported the code to NeoForge.

## 🌋 Features

Added the **Charred Stick** and **Red-Hot Stick** items, and added recipe to craft the **Blaze Rod**:

### **Charred Stick**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35d76684e2b61264d529c574cc02e54458af5480.png)

## 🔌 Dependencies

- **NeoForge** (1.21.1)
- **Create Mod** (v6.0.10)
